method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Global shares edge higher as central banks double down on inflation fight
Equities.reason: Central banks 'doubling down' on inflation frames a tightening/higher-for-longer rate regime — a negative macro backdrop for equities and risk assets despite the headline that shares inched up. This is a broad market macro driver so relevance is high.

Equities.title: Jane Street Joins Wave of Dealers Offering Swaps for Risky ETFs
Equities.reason: Market-structure/liquidity story: dealers offering swaps increases synthetic access to risky ETFs, likely supporting flows into risk assets and amplifying demand for equity beta — positive for equities but more tactical than macro.

Equities.title: AI’s Wobbly House of Cards Puts Markets and US Economy at Risk
Equities.reason: Negative systemic take on the AI-led market narrative — suggests AI exuberance is fragile and could transmit to broader market stress. High relevance because AI is a dominant leadership theme for equities.

Equities.title: SpaceX’s Nasdaq 100 Weight Is Confirmed at 2.82% in Rebalance
Equities.reason: Index-composition story: a confirmed material Nasdaq-100 weight implies rebalancing/ETF flows into large-cap names and further concentration of index returns — mildly positive for large-cap/tech-led indices.

Equities.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang emerges as Trump's top ally in AI safety debate
Equities.summary: Jensen Huang's position as the leader of the world's most valuable company, has earned him Trump's ear on the most important topics in AI.
Equities.reason: Reinforces Nvidia's and big-tech leadership in the AI narrative and signals political access/support that can reduce regulatory tail risks for large AI incumbents — positive for tech leadership and market sentiment.

Equities.title: S&P 500 Volume Spikes on $7 Trillion Options Day: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Extremely high options volume signals concentrated positioning and elevated tail-risk/volatility risk for equities. This increases the probability of sharp moves and is a negative for complacent risk-taking.

Equities.title: Saudi, Gulf stocks fall after Houthis claim Riyadh attacks
Equities.reason: Geopolitical shock hitting regional equity markets and energy-risk sentiment — negative for risk appetite and can feed through to global risk premia, especially energy/EM exposures.

Equities.title: Stocks face a growing list of threats — so why are investors staying so calm?
Equities.reason: Narrative of investor complacency vs. mounting macro/geopolitical/AI risks — implies vulnerability in risk assets and supports a cautious equities view.

Equities.title: Big Tech uses guarantees to keep $300bn AI exposure off balance sheets
Equities.summary: Wall Street finds new way to turn tech giants’ credit strength into cheaper funding for AI build-out
Equities.reason: Reveals hidden leverage/exposure mechanics used to finance AI expansion — supports the view that tech risk is masked and could amplify downside in stress. High relevance given tech's market leadership.

Equities.title: OpenAI's latest AI revelation is a 'serious situation,' Microsoft's Suleyman tells CNBC
Equities.summary: Suleyman joined "Squawk Box" to discuss OpenAI's latest incidents of "concerning model behavior" disclosed earlier this week.
Equities.reason: High-profile concerns about model behaviour raise regulatory and reputational risks for AI-focused stocks and the broader tech sector — negative for the dominant market leadership theme.

Equities.title: In China, A.I. Is Moving Forward While the Economy Lags Behind
Equities.reason: China-specific: AI progress versus weak macro suggests bifurcation — positive for selective Chinese tech names but negative for broader China equity exposure, so net mildly negative for global equities given China’s weight.

Equities.title: AI cloud provider Nscale files to go public
Equities.summary: Nscale is the latest artificial intelligence neocloud to turn to public markets.
Equities.reason: IPO pipeline for AI/cloud names supports continued investor appetite for AI assets and supply-side growth in the sector — modest positive for technology and equity issuance dynamics.

Rates.title: 10-year Treasury yield rises back to 5% as global tightening wave pushes
Rates.summary: US Treasury yields rise on Friday, boosted mainly by the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) decision to increase rates on Wednesday, while the Bank of Japan (BoJ) added its name to the list of major central banks focused on preventing inflation from getting out of contro
Rates.reason: Direct report of 10-year Treasury back at 5% — clear bond selloff driven by Fed tightening and a broad global hawkish cycle. High relevance for Rates as it signals materially higher yields and repricing of policy expectations.

Rates.title: Global rate-hike cycle in view as central banks take on inflation
Rates.reason: Broad macro narrative of a synchronized global tightening cycle — very negative for bond prices (yields higher). High relevance because it frames cross-market upward pressure on yields and global policy normalization.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve Board and Federal Open Market Committee release economic projections from the September 15-16 FOMC meeting
Rates.summary: Federal Reserve Board and Federal Open Market Committee release economic projections from the September 15-16 FOMC meeting
Rates.reason: Official FOMC projections are market-moving for rates expectations. Projections that imply higher-for-longer policy are strongly negative for bond prices; very high relevance to Rates.

Rates.title: Wall Street expects US to issue about $1tn of short-term debt as borrowing costs climb
Rates.summary: Growing reliance on Treasury bills comes as Scott Bessent seeks to curb rise in long-term rates
Rates.reason: Large increase in T-bill issuance raises Treasury supply and roll pressures amid rising borrowing costs — negative for bond prices, especially short-end and liquidity dynamics; meaningful but more technical than policy releases.

Rates.title: Asset Purchase Facility: Gilt Sales – Market Notice 17 September 2026
Rates.summary: This Market Notice outlines the Bank Executive’s approach to implementing the Monetary Policy Committee’s (MPC) decision to unwind the gilts held for monetary policy purposes in the Asset Purchase Facility (APF). As part of this, Bank APF auctions will be paus
Rates.reason: APF gilt sales (QT/unwinding) increase gilt supply and are explicitly negative for gilt prices (higher yields). High relevance for UK rates and the broader rates-supply narrative.

Rates.title: Bank rate maintained at 3.75% - September 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
Rates.summary: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee is responsible for making decisions about Bank Rate.
Rates.reason: BoE held Bank Rate but the context (no easing, ongoing QT) is mildly negative for gilt prices relative to a dovish/ cutting scenario. Moderate relevance — domestic policy confirmation rather than a shock.

Rates.title: Change in the Guideline for Money Market Operations
Rates.reason: BOJ operational changes signal shift in money market policy framework (linked to press reporting of BoJ tightening stance). That tends to lift JGB yields and contributes to global higher-for-longer narrative — negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Fed’s Schmid supports rate hike as inflation broadens beyond 3%
Rates.summary: On Friday, Kansas City Federal Reserve (Fed) President Jeffrey Schmid said he supported the rate hike, as “recent data suggest inflation trending above 3%.” Schmid added that tightening policy is a step toward achieving the Fed’s 2% goal, that inflation has br
Rates.reason: Regional Fed president endorsing hikes reinforces policy-tightening expectations and upward pressure on yields. Relevant as a policy signal but lower impact than FOMC-wide releases.

Rates.title: Bank of Canada: Rate path risks tilt earlier – RBC
Rates.summary: Nathan Janzen at Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) notes that markets are focused on whether the Bank of Canada (BoC) will raise rates in October after the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) move.
Rates.reason: Market focus on an earlier BoC tightening window increases Canadian and global rates uncertainty; relevant to cross-country rate differentials but a regional/anticipated development.

Rates.title: EM Investors Are Favoring Local Bonds as Dollar Debt Lags
Rates.reason: Flow shift into local-currency EM bonds supports those markets (price support) and changes demand patterns for global fixed income. Positive for local bond prices; relevant to global supply/demand dynamics.

Rates.title: Companies Avoid Selling The Bonds Investors Crave
Rates.reason: Lower corporate issuance reduces supply in the credit market, providing mild support to corporate bond prices. Relevant within credit markets but lower impact on sovereign rates.

Rates.title: Fed’s Kashkari says inflation is still too high across US economy, in Fox News interview
Rates.reason: Senior Fed official reiterating that inflation remains too high reinforces expectations for further tightening; negative for bond prices but less impactful than formal FOMC communications.

FX.title: Eurozone: Energy shock reshapes outlook – Rabobank
FX.summary: Rabobank strategists Bas van Geffen and Elwin de Groot highlight that sharply higher Oil and natural gas forecasts will lift headline Eurozone inflation by about 0.5 percentage points in 2026 and 2027.
FX.reason: Higher oil/gas-driven headline inflation raises ECB tightening prospects -> supportive for EUR vs USD (EURUSD strength). Material regional macro impact on FX.

FX.title: British Pound gives back UK sales pop as Oil shock returns
FX.summary: The Pound Sterling (GBP) retraces on Friday after reaching a daily high of 1.3375 on upbeat UK data, as headlines suggest that an Oil supply shock has sent crude prices higher and reignited investors' fears of high inflation. At the time of writing, the GBP/US
FX.reason: Oil supply shock revives inflation fears and risk/repricing that undercut GBP’s post-data gains -> near-term sterling softness vs USD (GBPUSD pressure).

FX.title: South Korean Won: Foreign equity flows keep KRW heavy against US Dollar – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC strategist Christopher Wong notes that the Korean Won remains under pressure as foreign selling of Korean equities persists and elevated US yields after the FOMC continue to weigh. Large-cap technology stocks are at the centre of outflows, though the broa
FX.reason: Persistent equity outflows + higher US yields keep KRW weak vs USD -> reflects USD-supported EMFX pressure from yield and cross-asset flows.

FX.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Technical setup favours further gains above 100
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY) climbs to a fresh seven-week high on Friday, supported by the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) hawkish interest rate hike on Wednesday. At the time of writing, the index trades around 100.40 and is on track to register a weekly gain of more th
FX.reason: Technical and Fed-driven upside in DXY implies broader USD strength -> negative for major currencies (EUR/GBP/AUD/CAD/JPY) and EMFX.

FX.title: European Central Bank: Quarterly hikes still baseline – Nordea
FX.summary: Nordea’s team sees the European Central Bank delivering two more 25bp rate hikes, in December and March 2027, despite more aggressive market pricing.
FX.reason: Nordea expects additional ECB hikes -> supports EUR via higher rate differentials against USD; meaningful regional policy-driven FX signal.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Dovish BoJ hike weighs on yen – Scotiabank
FX.summary: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret note the Japanese Yen (JPY) is down sharply versus the US Dollar (USD) after a dovishly delivered 25 bps Bank of Japan (BoJ) hike and Governor Ueda’s cautious guidance.
FX.reason: Dovish BoJ hike and cautious guidance weaken JPY despite higher policy rate -> USD/JPY upside and broader USD support; central-bank divergence is a strong FX driver.

FX.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Kiwi reversal puts 0.5700 under pressure
FX.summary: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) turns negative on Friday, down 0.11% against the US Dollar (USD), in a week that saw the Federal Reserve's (Fed) first rate hike in three years, which underpinned the Greenback against most G8 FX currencies.
FX.reason: Fed hike underpinned USD and weighed on NZD; this is a pair-specific technical/flow note (technical relevance capped) indicating NZD pressure vs USD.

FX.title: Euro: Stabilization after FOMC volatility – Scotiabank
FX.summary: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret report the Euro (EUR) is posting a small gain versus the US Dollar (USD) as EUR/USD extends Thursday’s modest recovery and attempts to stabilize after the latest FOMC meeting.
FX.reason: Short-term EUR stabilization after FOMC volatility; modest EUR recovery vs USD but limited scope absent a clear policy surprise.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Bulls eye 0.7200 after 0.7100 break
FX.summary: The Aussie Dollar is poised to end the week on a positive note versus the US Dollar, up 0.21% as improved risk appetite keeps AUD/USD trading near 0.7124, closing near Friday's highs.
FX.reason: Risk-appetite-led AUD gains vs USD noted (technical/flow-driven). Price-forecast piece -> limited relevance but contributes to AUD sentiment.

FX.title: Chinese Yuan: Pre-summit support and firmer bias – DBS
FX.summary: Chang Wei Liang at DBS Group Research highlights that USD/CNH is easing toward 6.70 despite a stronger Dollar, with the Renminbi (RMB) supported by a lower USD/CNY fixing below 6.76.
FX.reason: Authorities' fixing and pre-summit support keep RMB firmer vs USD despite broad USD strength -> relevant for EM/Asia FX flows and USD/CNH dynamics.

FX.title: Singapore Dollar: Strong NODX but USD still drives USD/SGD – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC’s Christopher Wong highlights that Singapore’s August NODX surged 46.2% year-on-year, far above consensus, with electronics exports jumping on AI-related demand and broad-based strength across markets.
FX.reason: Domestic export strength supports SGD but USD remains the dominant driver of USD/SGD; underscores USD-led moves in Asian FX.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar: Pressure builds near 1.40 against US Dollar - Scotiabank
FX.summary: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret note the Canadian Dollar (CAD) remains under pressure near 1.40 against the Dollar, reflecting a firm USD tone and wider US–Canada front-end spreads.
FX.reason: Firm USD tone and US–Canada front-end spread dynamics put CAD under pressure vs USD -> important cross-border rate differential signal for CAD.

Commodities.title: Gold outlook hinges on Oil prices and shifting Fed expectations
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) loses momentum after nearing the $4,400 level on Friday as the Federal Reserve’s hawkish policy outlook keeps the US Dollar firmly supported, while a rebound in Oil prices and US Treasury yields adds pressure on the metal.
Commodities.reason: Gold reacting to hawkish Fed expectations, stronger USD, rising oil and yields — net negative pressure on bullion prices (macro liquidity/yields transmission).

Commodities.title: Gold reclaims its footing as Oil retreat blunts Fed shock
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) price extends its gains on Friday, edging up 0.89% as Oil prices eased despite renewed concerns of supply shortages and despite a week that featured a rate hike by the Federal Reserve (Fed), which pushed the yellow metal to a nearly two-month lo
Commodities.reason: Near-term rebound as oil eases offsets some Fed-driven USD strength — positive for gold but more of a tactical move (price/flow-driven).

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: Mild bullish bias holds, but trend strength stays weak
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) trades on the front foot on Friday as the US Dollar reverses its intraday gains, with traders booking profits following the Greenback’s strong weekly advance.
Commodities.reason: Tactical silver upside as USD retreats intraday; technical/forecast piece so lower relevance despite direct commodity linkage.

Commodities.title: Corpus Christi LNG expansion makes facility the second-largest in the United States
Commodities.summary: On August 28, 2026, Cheniere Energy, Inc., completed its Corpus Christi Liquefaction Stage 3 Project (CCL Stage 3) in Texas, taking custody and control of the seventh and last liquefied natural gas (LNG) train in the project.
Commodities.reason: Added US LNG liquefaction capacity increases export demand for US natural gas (structural support for domestic gas prices) — clear supply/demand transmission into natural gas commodity.

Commodities.title: Hormuz Oil Shipments Hit Six-Month High, US Commander Says
Commodities.reason: Higher shipments through Strait of Hormuz imply stronger flows to market and ease of supply concerns — bearish for crude/oil prices.

Commodities.title: World Running Short of Supertankers Threatens Long-Haul Oil Flow
Commodities.reason: Logistics constraint (supertanker shortage) threatens long-haul crude flows — effective tightening of global supply, bullish for oil prices.

Commodities.title: Ukraine hits Moscow with ‘largest ever’ drone attack
Commodities.summary: Major oil refinery in Russian capital set ablaze as voting draws to a close in stage-managed parliamentary elections
Commodities.reason: Significant supply disruption risk from refinery attack in a major oil producer — high-impact geo-risk that supports higher oil/prices across the complex.

Commodities.title: US retailer rations motor oil as prices quadruple and supplies run dry
Commodities.summary: Iran war has created global shortage of lubricant used in vehicle engines
Commodities.reason: Lubricant shortages (downstream products) signal stress in refined product markets and supply-chain tightness — supportive for oil/commodity complex.

Commodities.title: What goes into diesel prices?
Commodities.summary: The price of distillate fuel oil, often sold as diesel, is driven by the price of crude oil, retail margins, distribution costs, taxes, and crack spreads, the indicator we use for refining margins. Tight global supplies of distillate fuel oil and elevated crud
Commodities.reason: EIA notes tight distillate supplies and linkage to crude — implies upside pressure for crude and refined product prices (informational but directly relevant).

Commodities.title: Venezuela, TotalEnergies Pave Way for Oil Company’s Return
Commodities.reason: Re-entry of international oil company activity in Venezuela points to potential increase in future supply — bearish for oil prices (supply upside).

Commodities.title: Chevron (CVX) Supercharges its Venezuela Bet with More Oil Rigs
Commodities.reason: Chevron increasing rigs in Venezuela suggests higher future output from an oil-bearing jurisdiction — modest bearish signal for crude supply expectations.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin slips 1% but above $80,000 as ETF inflows revive institutional demand
Crypto.reason: ETF inflows and renewed institutional demand are a clear positive for crypto market liquidity and price discovery; large market-moving implication for BTC and broader crypto sentiment.

Crypto.title: Layer-2 and DeFi tokens lead broad crypto advance as post-Fed hike nerves fade
Crypto.reason: Altcoin/DeFi leadership suggests broader risk-on rotation within crypto and recovery of speculative flows after macro rate jitters — supportive for market breadth.

Crypto.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs over $80,000 as crypto shakes off Clarity failure and higher interest rates
Crypto.reason: Price action showing resilience after regulatory setback (Clarity failure) and higher rates reinforces bullish technical momentum and market confidence.

Crypto.title: Ether and XRP ETFs post outflows as crypto majors move higher
Crypto.reason: Flow rotation away from ETH/XRP ETFs toward other crypto (notably BTC) signals concentration of capital but limited ecosystem weakness — small net positive for BTC-led rally, modest relevance.

Crypto.title: Bank of Japan raises interest rates by 25 basis points. Bitcoin tops $77,000
Crypto.reason: Central-bank tightening normally pressures risk assets, but BTC rising despite a BoJ hike points to decoupling/resilience — mildly positive signal for crypto's risk premium.

Crypto.title: CFTC sends crypto rules to White House to review as Congress stalls on Clarity Act
Crypto.reason: Regulatory path via CFTC could provide clearer, market-friendly rules compared with legislative gridlock — meaningful positive for institutional participation and long-term structure.

Crypto.title: Crypto tech provider Haruko hit by cyberattack affecting 15 clients, some funds lost
Crypto.reason: Operational/custodial security incidents increase counterparty and custody risk, undermining investor confidence and posing downside to flows and adoption.

Crypto.title: Corporate treasuries bought just 5,900 bitcoin in 3 months. Other demand signals look weak, too.
Crypto.reason: Evidence of weak corporate demand reduces a key institutional adoption narrative and represents a negative fundamental signal for medium-term inflows.

Crypto.title: Ripple says asset managers are preparing for XRP Ledger’s next payments upgrade
Crypto.reason: Payments-focused infrastructure upgrades and asset-manager preparation indicate real-world adoption potential for XRP Ledger — constructive for token utility and flows.

Crypto.title: Crypto Blew Its Big Moment—and the Blame Game Has Begun
Crypto.reason: Prominent critical narratives about missed opportunities and governance/industry failings can weigh on sentiment and long-term confidence; notable negative PR risk.

Crypto.title: Zcash targets November upgrade to make private payments up to three times faster
Crypto.reason: Technical upgrades that improve privacy payments performance are incremental positives for protocol utility and niche adoption.

Crypto.title: Iran’s Strait of Hormuz toll booth ran through a bitcoin exchange, U.S. says
Crypto.reason: Reports of bitcoin being used in sanctionable state-linked activity raise compliance and reputational risks, potentially prompting stricter oversight or enforcement.
